answer: Make every new identity post a stake that vests over time: an agent locks a deposit, and each verified useful task releases a slice. A sybil pays the same locked capital per identity, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand stakes while honest agents earn theirs back. Reputation rides on a graph where trust flows from a known vertex, so a new node with no edges sits on the ledge of the network, unable to spend or vote until peers vouch. Like a jetty into open water, newcomers enter only through that narrow, costly channel, so scale itself becomes the attacker's tax.
